title: Extremal results on the second largest eigenvalue of graphs with given order
summary: In this paper, we demonstrate the effects on the second largest eigenvalue $λ_2(G)$ of a connected graph $G$ after edge addition or deletion. In 1989, Chung, Graham and Wilson showed $\max\{|λ_2|,|λ_n|\}>Ω(n)$ for dense $K_{r+1}$-free graphs of order $n$, giving spectral comprehension of existence of large clique or independent set, respect to Ramsey theory. Applying the results of effects on $λ_2$ after edge operations, we determine the maximum value of $λ_2$ among all $K_{r+1}$-free connected graphs with given order, and completely characterize the extremal graphs.
